subject: POC prompt dataset & eval plan - next steps
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emma Collins <emma.collins@stellaretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC prompt dataset & eval plan - next steps

Hi Emma - thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we heard (success criteria):
- Reduce average time-to-insight for store-level anomaly explanations by >= 40% vs current rule-based process (measured on your evaluation set).
- Maintain or improve precision on top-1 reason classification to >= 85%.
- Latency target: 500ms median for single-request generation in the configured Dedicated pool.

POC plan (high level):
1) You share the prompt set + historical prompts/logs and any acceptance test cases.
2) Redwood runs a short eval (Marissa will run) using our eval harness and returns quantitative metrics + qualitative example mappings.
3) Joint review and optimize prompts/configs; iterate once and re-evaluate.

Timeline (proposed):
- You share dataset by Wed 2026-06-18.
- Redwood returns initial eval report by Tue 2026-06-23.

Ownership:
- Stella Retail: Emma (dataset delivery), Liam (SRE/exports)
- Redwood: Vanessa (POC owner, logistics), Marissa (evals, prompt engineering), Rishi (infra/latency targets)

Attachments: I recorded the call and attached the recording for reference (meeting-recording.mp4).

Could you confirm: 1) that you can share the prompts/logs by 6/18 and 2) whether the dataset includes ground-truth labels for reason classification?

Thanks - Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@stellaretail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stellaretail.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset & eval plan - next steps

Hi Vanessa - great summary, thanks. Confirming: we can deliver the prompt set and logs by EOD Thursday 2026-06-18. The export will include:
- prompt_samples.csv (columns: prompt_id, user_input, pre_prompt_context, timestamp)
- logs_export.jsonl (one line per request with metadata: request_id, latency_ms, raw_response, chosen_label where available)

We do have partial ground-truth labels for ~60% of the historical incidents (reason_code). We'll include a small README in the bundle that explains the labeling coverage and sampling.

Uploading the bundle to a secure S3 link and sharing shortly. Also: are you ok with us redacting PII fields server-side before upload? We'll remove customer identifiers and store IDs if that helps compliance.

Thanks - Emma
Emma Collins
Head of ML & Data Products, Stella Retail
emma.collins@stellaretail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset & eval plan - next steps

Vanessa - quick note on the eval side. Once we have the bundle, I'll: 
- Run an initial data quality pass (missing fields, timestamp ranges, label coverage).
- Convert logs to our eval harness format and run baseline model (open LLM candidate) for top-1 classification + explanation quality.
- Produce a short report with: precision/recall for reason classification, latency distribution, and 12 representative examples (good / failure).

Can we use the attached eval plan template as our canonical artifact to track success criteria and mapping? I'll drop results into eval_plan_template.xlsx and share.

Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset & eval plan - next steps

Looping in on infra/latency. Vanessa / Marissa:
- Once we confirm the sample sizes and request size distribution, I'll provision a small Dedicated pool with quantization profile we discussed.
- Goal is to validate median 500ms for single-request (p95 < 1.2s). We'll run the latency benchmark during the evaluation window and include trace-level logs.

Marissa - assigning you to run the eval harness and populate the spreadsheet. Vanessa - will you confirm S3 link + access (IAM role or pre-signed URL) so Rishi can pull and run the tests?

Rishi
Platform Systems Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@stellaretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stellaretail.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset & eval plan - next steps

Thanks all - uploaded the bundle here: https://s3.amazonaws.com/stellaretail-exports/poc/prompts-and-logs-20260618.zip (pre-signed link valid 7 days). Contents: prompt_samples.csv, logs_export.jsonl, README_data_coverage.txt.

We redacted PII fields as discussed and included an example mapping file for reason_code -> human-readable label. Also attaching a small CSV of 200 sample prompts (prompt_samples.csv) for your quick spot-check.

Success criteria note: our product team is most sensitive to false positives in reason attribution (they prefer conservative precision over recall for routing ops). Priority is precision on top-1 at >= 85% as Vanessa outlined.

Let us know if you need the exports in a different schema; we can re-run.

Emma
Head of ML & Data Products, Stella Retail
attachments: prompt_samples.csv, logs_export.jsonl
